steps.sql: SELECT st, TRY_CONVERT(varchar(40), CAST(1.5 AS float), st) AS f, TRY_CONVERT(varchar(40), CAST(0.1 AS real), st) AS r, TRY_CONVERT(varchar(40), CAST(1.5 AS money), st) AS m FROM (VALUES (0),(1),(2),(3),(4),(5),(6),(20),(21),(100),(101),(102),(103),(120),(121),(126),(127),(128),(129),(130),(200),(-1)) v(st)
SELECT CONVERT(varchar(30), CAST(0.1 AS float), 3), CONVERT(varchar(30), CAST(-1e300 AS float), 3), CONVERT(varchar(30), CAST(0.1 AS real), 1), CONVERT(varchar(30), CAST(0.1 AS real), 2) AS v
